scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @webpulse/shared build && pnpm --filter @webpulse/tracker build && pnpm --parallel --filter @webpulse/server --filter @webpulse/dashboard dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @webpulse/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test:postgres: pnpm --filter @webpulse/shared build && pnpm --filter @webpulse/tracker build && vitest run --project postgres
scripts.test:sdk: pnpm --filter @webpulse/shared build && pnpm --filter @webpulse/tracker build && playwright test -c playwright.sdk.config.ts
